adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a `raw_html` cook path in `Post#cook` that returns `raw` verbatim (`return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`). `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: :raw_html` and sets `raw` to `absolutize_urls(url, contents)`, where `absolutize_urls` only rewrites leading-slash `href`/`src` values via Nokogiri and does not sanitize tags/attributes or filter dangerous URL schemes. Feed-imported content comes from `Jobs::PollFeed` (`content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`), which performs no XSS sanitization. The embed view renders `raw post.cooked` in `app/views/embed/best.html.erb`, and for `raw_html` posts `cooked == raw`, creating a direct HTML sink. Therefore untrusted RSS/remote content can inject scripts/handlers/`javascript:` links into the embedded iframe.
